mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS menu_id, m.cat_id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, m.name, m.price, m.image_url, m.description, m.sold_out FROM menu m JOIN category c ON c.id = m.cat_id WHERE m.id = #{menuId}

SELECT ingredient_id AS ingredientId, ing_name AS name, ing_sold_out AS isSoldOut, role, quantity, unit, is_default AS isDefault, can_remove AS canRemove, sort_no AS sortNo, allergens FROM vw_menu_ing_json WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}

SELECT option_group_id AS optionGroupId, name, group_type AS groupType, select_type AS selectType, min_select AS minSelect, max_select AS maxSelect, sort_order AS sortOrder, is_required AS isRequired, items FROM vw_menu_opt_policy_json WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
